assets.title: Equal opposite pulls
assets.prompt: Use case: educational illustration. AlloFlow Grade 3 Forces and Motion. Friendly clean painterly classroom illustration, natural colors, simple pale background, one clear idea. Absolutely no text, letters, digits, labels, captions, logos, watermarks or decorative symbols. Only requested plain arrows. Physically plausible objects and anatomy. Native app supplies all words. Landscape 3:2 composition. Simple classroom model: a short straight rope held taut by one hand at each end, a small red ribbon at its center. Above the rope are two separated horizontal blue arrows of EXACTLY equal length and width, one pointing left and the other right. Full hands visible. No people or other arrows.
assets.alt: Two hands hold a taut rope with a central red ribbon. Matching blue arrows above point left and right.
assets.caption: The matching arrows model equal opposite horizontal pulls on the rope. If it starts still, it stays still while these pulls balance. The centered ribbon alone does not measure force.

assets.title: Unequal horizontal pulls
assets.prompt: Use case: educational illustration. AlloFlow Grade 3 Forces and Motion. Friendly clean painterly classroom illustration, natural colors, simple pale background, one clear idea. Landscape 3:2 composition. A small wooden cart centered on a flat floor has a taut cord extending from each side. Above the LEFT cord a short orange arrow points left. Above the RIGHT cord a much longer blue arrow points right. No motion trails; this is a force model, not a speed measurement. No people.
assets.alt: Cords extend from both sides of a wooden cart. A short orange arrow points left; a longer blue arrow points right.
assets.caption: The longer right arrow models the larger pull. If these are the only horizontal forces, the cart's motion changes toward the right. A cart moving left could first slow down.

assets.title: Changing ramp height
assets.prompt: Landscape 3:2 friendly watercolor classroom illustration on a pale background. Two separate empty straight wooden ramps side by side in a clear side view. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos or watermarks.
assets.caption: Change ramp height while keeping the ball, ramp, release place, and floor consistent. Measure several trials before predicting how the height will affect rolling distance.
assets.alt: Two empty wooden ramps rest on books. The shallow ramp at left has one book beneath its raised end; the steeper ramp at right has a taller support with three books.
